fee_details:
- First Year Membership Fee: Rs.1,999 (plus taxes) waived if Rs. 60,000 is spent within 30 days from the time the card is set up.
- Renewal Membership Fee: Rs. 1,999 (plus taxes) waived if Rs. 60,000 is spent within 12 months before the renewal date.
joining_perks: The YES Bank RESERVE Credit Card (previously YES FIRST Credit Card) provides reward points on any online shopping. With the credit card domestic and international airport lounge access is provided. The process to apply for the credit card is easy and can be completed online.
reward_structure: - 4 YES Reward Points on every Rs.200 that is spent on select categories. 2 YES Reward Points on every Rs.200 that is spent on shopping online on select categories. 1 YES Reward Points on every Rs.200 that is spent on shopping offline on select categories.
key_highlights:
- Insurance coverage up to Rs.5 Lakh for loss of valuables.
- Domestic and international airport lounge access.
- Fuel surcharge waiver.
- Golf lessons and a free green fee at certain golf courses in the country.

benefits_features.Insurance Coverage: Lost Card Liability: Rs.15 lakh, Rs.20 Lakh Credit Card Cover: Rs.15 Lakh
benefits_features.Domestic Lounge Program: 2 complimentary visits per quarter in India
benefits_features.International Lounge Program: Via Mastercard airport lounges will have international airport lounge access
benefits_features.Fuel Surcharge Waiver: Fuel surcharge waiver of 1% between Rs.400 and Rs.5000
benefits_features.Golf Program: 1 golf lesson and a free green fee at certain golf courses in the country

how_tos.Card Payment: Customers can make NET banking, and cash or cheque-based bank standing instructions for their payments from YES Bank Credit Cards

miscellaneous:
Eligibility Criteria:
You must be between the ages of 21 years and 60 years.
Self-employed individuals and salaried employees can apply for the card.
Your net salary must be Rs. 16,000 per month or the annual income must be Rs.192,000.

faqs.What is the minimum amount/purchase that: Using the card, transactions whose value is Rs.3,500 can be converted into EMIs and paid off over 3 to 24 months.
